integrity: The proof classifies every similarity type in the two-dimensional general linear group, computes the tensor fixed-space dimension in each type, and counts all relevant resonance relations. A standalone checker constructs the eight-dimensional tensor operator for every invertible matrix over five finite fields and verifies the formulas directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem solves only the matrix-dimension-two case of the general fixed-tensor distribution problem.
The proof uses the standard similarity-class classification and centralizer sizes in the two-dimensional general linear group.
The final algebra-isomorphism counts are prior results and are used only as a consistency check.
title: The dimension-two fixed-tensor distribution over every finite field
